text.p: Enova Corp and Pacific Enterprises said on Monday they had agreed to merge to form a new company with a market value of $5.2 billion.

Under the merger agreement, Pacific Enterprises shareholders will get 1.5038 shares of the new company's stock for each share of Pacific they own. Enova shareholders will receive one share of the new company for each of their Enova shares.

The companies said they expect the merger to produce cost savings of about $1.2 billion over the next 10 years through synergies and economies of scale. The savings will come mainly from combining and reducing management and administrative functions, they said.
The new company's dividend is expected to be set at $1.56 per share annually, which is the dividend currently paid to Enova shareholders, the companies said.
The deal is to be accounted for as a pooling of interests and, subject to regulatory and shareholder approval, is expected to close by the end of 1997, the companies said.

They said Richard Farman, president and chief operating officer of Pacific Enterprises, will become chairman and chief executive of the new company. Stephen Baum, president and chief executive of Enova, will become vice chairman, president and chief operating officer.
Baum will become CEO two years after the effective date of the merger and will add the title of chairman by September 2000, when Farman is to retire.
Thomas Page, chairman of Enova, will retire at the end of December 1997, and Willis Wood, chairman and CEO of Pacific Enterprises, will retire upon completion of the merger, the companies said.
The board of the new company, which will include Farman and Baum, will have an equal number of outside directors from both companies.

The companies said that on a pro forma basis, the new company will have about 60 percent of its revenue from gas operations, about 35 percent from electric operations, and the rest from other operations.
Enova is the parent company of San Diego Gas & Electric. Pacific Enterprises is the parent company of Southern California Gas Co.
